authority: owner corrections 2026-08-18; both verified factually before adoption, not adopted on say-so

correction_1_IDENTITY_TERM.the_factual_test_the_owner_set: the term 'leakage' applies only if postgame starter identity entered a pregame feature — which would have DISQUALIFIED the development run.
correction_1_IDENTITY_TERM.verification_performed: traced what the fit consumed. Every sp stat field is strict-prior (build_ml_asof enforces last_start_date < slate_date with its own gate). The identity selects WHICH pitcher's pregame stats enter — and the first pitcher of a game is determined before first pitch by definition; no outcome of the game feeds back into who threw its first pitch. The dataset merely MEASURED that pregame fact through a postgame record because pregame probables were not archived.
correction_1_IDENTITY_TERM.verdict: the build remained CAUSAL. The development run is not disqualified. 'Measurement limitation' is the accurate term: the identity variable carries measurement error relative to the pregame-known probable (the 8/17 Lowder G1/G2 case is exactly such an error), not information from the future.
correction_1_IDENTITY_TERM.residual_caveat_kept: openers and bullpen games blur 'the starter' as a concept; the first-pitcher definition is applied uniformly and stated.
